name: Partiful 公开活动页（Abbode Sample Sale）与首页邀请卡
creator: Partiful
observation: 手机版活动页自上而下：居中的灰色胶囊「🌐 Public Event」→ 宽体衬线大标题（约为正文 2 倍）→ 16px 边距内的正方形海报 → 时间写成两行「Sat, Apr 11 · 11:00am —」/「Sun, Apr 12 · 6:00pm」（约正文 1.4 倍）→「Hosted by」每位主办人为 56px 圆头像，右下角压一枚黑色小皇冠徽章 → 地点被替换为链接「Sign in to see location」→「Guest List」标题下一行用中点分隔三个计数「1722 Went · 187 Interested · 62 Maybe」，再一排 5 个相互叠压的 56px 头像加一枚灰色「+1.7k」圆片；再往下的动态流整体高斯模糊，中央浮一张「Restricted Access」卡（锁图标、说明、通栏黑色 Sign in 按钮），页脚才恢复清晰。首页 hero 的邀请卡把 RSVP 做成三枚带 emoji 的白色圆形按钮「Going / Maybe / Can't go」，Guest List 行写「16 Going · 2 Maybe」+ 叠压头像。
translation: 名单的角色分层：主办人靠头像角上的皇冠徽章而不是单独分组来区分；局卡/详情的人数行照抄「N 已到 · N 感兴趣 · N 待定」的中点单行写法，历史局用过去式计数；未报名者看详情时把动态区模糊并盖一张门禁卡，而不是整段隐藏；RSVP 三圆钮可直接用于局详情底部。
auditNote: ev0 shows the grey 'Public Event' pill, wide-serif title, square poster and the two-line 'Sat, Apr 11 · 11:00am — / Sun, Apr 12 · 6:00pm' time; ev1 shows 'Hosted by' 56px avatars each with a small black crown badge, 'Sign in to see location', and 'Guest List' with '1722 Went · 187 Interested · 62 Maybe' plus five overlapping avatars and a grey '+1.7k' chip; ev2 shows the feed blurred under a 'Restricted Access' card (lock, copy, full-width black Sign in) with the footer crisp; sec1 shows the Going/Maybe/Can't go round emoji buttons and '16 Going · 2 Maybe'. Minor inaccuracy: that invite card is in the 'Fun, modern invites' section below the hero, not in the hero. URL is Partiful's own event page (original source); not an excluded work; ui category and static status are correct; translation names concrete JU surfaces (局卡/详情人数行, 未报名者看详情, 局详情底部 RSVP).

name: Luma 活动页（Friends of the Studio: Home Cafe / Rough Draft / Miles & Mimosas 三种报名状态）
creator: Luma (luma.com)
observation: 手机版：正方形海报底部压一条半透明「Featured in New York」缎带；衬线标题约正文 2 倍；主办方为小头像+名字链接；日期用一枚迷你日历片（红色大写「OCT」在上、日数「10」在下）配右侧「Saturday, October 10 / 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM EDT」，地点用同尺寸的定位片配「St. Lydia's ↗ / Brooklyn, NY」；「Get Tickets」卡有灰色标题带，首行是闹钟图标「Limited Spots Remaining」；票种为纵向堆叠的圆角行：售罄行整体变灰并在名称下挂灰色「Sold Out」胶囊，可选行用 1.5px 深色描边 + 左侧实心勾圈 + 「1 Left」胶囊，价格右对齐，「Early Bird Ticket」行写「● Sales ended Sep 30, 11:59 PM EDT」；底部通栏紫色「Get Ticket」。同一张报名卡的另两种状态：Rough Draft（桌面版两栏：左 200px 海报 + Hosted By 列表，右列标题/时间/报名）写「Event Full / If you'd like, you can join the waitlist.」并配橙色「Join Waitlist」；Miles & Mimosas 写「Sold Out / This event is sold out and no longer taking registrations.」且不再给按钮。
translation: 局详情的报名卡与状态文案：满员=候补按钮、售罄=只留说明、名额紧张=闹钟提示行；票种行的「描边+勾圈+N Left」是「已选/待确认」的写法；改期弹层旧→新对照可沿用这枚月份在上、日数在下的日历片做新旧两枚并排。
auditNote: hc0 shows the 'Featured in New York' ribbon on the poster, serif title, host link, OCT/10 date tile with 'Saturday, October 10 / 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM EDT', location tile 'St. Lydia's ↗ / Brooklyn, NY', and the 'Get Tickets' card with alarm icon 'Limited Spots Remaining'; hc1 shows greyed 'Sold Out' rows with grey pills, the selected row with dark outline + filled check circle + '1 Left', 'Early Bird Ticket ● Sales ended Sep 30, 11:59 PM EDT', and the full-width purple 'Get Ticket'; rd shows the desktop two-column layout with 'Event Full / If you'd like, you can join the waitlist.' and orange 'Join Waitlist'; mm0 shows 'Sold Out / This event is sold out and no longer taking registrations.' with no button. name: Apple Invites — Upcoming 列表的 Hosting 徽标与 Guest List（Apple Newsroom 2025-02-04）
creator: Apple
observation: Upcoming 屏：满幅照片卡的左上角压一枚带皇冠图标的胶囊「Hosting」，顶栏「Upcoming ⌄」右侧是 + 与头像。Guest List 面板：顶部一簇约 12 个大小不一的 memoji 头像（中央一枚约为其他 1.5 倍），其下按「HOST」（单行）和「GOING (9)」两个小写灰标题分组；每行是半透明深色单元，放在活动海报的模糊放大版之上，内容为头像、姓名、以及姓名下方斜体的个人留言（「I'll be there! 🎉」「I'm in!」「❤️❤️❤️❤️」），右端「···」；左上角 ×。编辑态的邀请卡是叠在背景照片上的一列半透明圆角单元：Event Title → Date and Time → Location → Hosted by（头像）+「Add a description.」。
translation: 我发起的局 vs 我参加的局：局卡角上的「Hosting」皇冠胶囊是最直接的区分方式；名单的角色分层照「HOST」单独一组 +「GOING (9)」计数标题；报名留言放在姓名下方斜体一行；局卡→详情的展开可把背景海报模糊放大作为详情底色。
auditNote: f00 and s0 show the Upcoming screen with the crown 'Hosting' pill on the photo card and 'Upcoming ⌄' with + and avatar; f07 shows the Guest List panel: memoji cluster with a larger central one, 'HOST' single row, 'GOING (9)' header, translucent rows with italic messages ('I'll be there! 🎉', 'I'm in!', hearts), '···' at right, × top-left, over a blurred poster backdrop; f04 shows the edit-state stack Event Title → Date and Time → Location → Hosted by + 'Add a description.'. Apple Newsroom is the publisher's original source; Apple Invites is not on the exclusion list (only Apple Sports is); ui/static correct; translation names 局卡角上, 名单角色分层, 报名留言, 局卡→详情.

name: Apple Wallet 票证设计规范（HIG Wallet 页 + Wallet Overview）
creator: Apple
observation: Event ticket 样式（Concert）是竖向圆角矩形，上边缘中央切一个半圆缺口；顶行左侧类别+图标「Concert」，右侧小写字标「ACCESS」+值「VIP」；之后是两层标签/值：EVENT、LOCATION 竖排在左，右侧一枚方形缩略图；再一行 TIME / LEVEL / ROW / SEAT（标签约 9pt 大写加字距，值约 15pt）；下方约 45% 高是模糊的全幅艺术底图，中央放白色条码板。健身卡对照图说明标签对比度：紫底白标 ✓，紫底品红标 ✗。Wallet Overview：钱包视图中票证层叠，每张只露约 40px 的头带；展开后左上 ×、右上分享/···，事件票示例「RICH vs SWE」下方是 VIP / 3 / 12 / 5 的四格小字。
translation: 票根撕票：JU 局票的解剖=顶部缺口 + 头带（左类别右状态）+ 标签/值栅格 + 底部码板；撕票沿缺口所在的水平线撕开；「已报名/候补/已签到」写进头带右槽（对应 ACCESS/VIP）；历史区的层叠按钱包视图只露头带。
auditNote: hig_scroll6400/7000 show the Concert event-ticket pass with a top-center semicircular notch, 'Concert' + icon left and 'ACCESS / VIP' right, EVENT/LOCATION labels with a square thumbnail, TIME/LEVEL/ROW/SEAT row, blurred full-art background and white barcode plate, plus the purple gym cards with white labels (✓) vs magenta labels (✗); hig_scroll5800 shows the design guidance text; dev_s0 shows the Wallet view with stacked passes exposing only header bands; dev_s1 shows the 'RICH vs SWE' event ticket with VIP / 3 / 12 / 5. developer.apple.com HIG is the original source; not excluded; ui/static correct; translation names 票根撕票, 头带右槽, 历史区层叠.

No surprises later.」+ 黑色胶囊按钮；各区块用 1px 细线分隔：Lineup（3 个叠压的 56px 圆形艺人照 + 一枚写「1」的计数圆环）、Venue（名称、地址、带定位图标的灰色「OPEN IN MAPS」胶囊、白色「FOLLOW」胶囊，右侧场馆黑白图形）、「Doors open 3:00 PM EDT」行。dice.fm 首页的 App 截图里，购票面板为白色圆角卡：「General admission / £64.32」旁贴一枚极小的黑底「WAIT LIST」标签；数量步进器的数字落在一个两侧带缺口的黑色票形方块里；通栏黑色「JOIN WAIT LIST」胶囊；活动头部的日期「Fri, 25 Apr, 18:30」用荧光黄，场馆用灰。

name: Flighty — My Flights 列表密度与延误时间线（flighty.com）
creator: Flighty
observation: My Flights 列表每行三栏：左栏是大号时长数字「1h」上、「38 MINUTES」小写大写字在下；中栏为航司小 logo + 灰色航班号「DL 383」、粗体航线「San Francisco to New York」、再一行两枚带绿点的时间片「SFO 09:10」「JFK 17:25」；状态写在小字行右端：「Departs On Time」绿色、「Departs 43m late」红色。延误卡：红色「RUNNING LATE」徽章 →一句原因「35m delay predicted due to late arriving aircraft」→ 一条竖向时间线，当前航段放飞机图标，每个停靠点（SFO/JFK/SAN）是空心或实心圆，每段右端红色「52m Late」「10m Late」。页面 hero 有通知卡先于手机渐入（f01 仅卡片 → f03 手机出现），但那是营销页进场，不是 App 动效。
translation: 我参加的局列表行密度：左大号日/时、中局名+地点、右状态字（已确认绿/待确认灰/候补橙）；改期弹层旧→新对照可用竖向停靠点时间线，旧时间空心、新时间实心并在右端标「晚 2 小时」。
auditNote: f08.png shows the My Flights list on flighty.com with the three-column rows: large '1h' over '38 MINUTES', airline logo + 'DL 383', bold 'San Francisco to New York', green-dot time chips 'SFO 09:10' / 'JFK 17:25', and status text 'Departs On Time' (green) vs 'Departs 43m late' (red). delay-timeline_crop.png shows the red 'RUNNING LATE' badge, '35m delay predicted due to late arriving aircraft', and the vertical timeline with plane icon, SFO/JFK/SAN hollow/filled stops and '52m Late' / '10m Late' at right. s1.png places that card on the Flighty marketing page. URL is the creator's own site. Observation honestly notes the hero animation is marketing entrance, not app motion, so 仅核验静态 is correct. Translation is concrete (我参加的局列表行, 改期弹层停靠点时间线). Not excluded.

name: Family（family.co）首页特性网格的分步进场与状态计数动效
creator: Family (family.co)
observation: 3×2 的特性网格在约 3 秒内分步填充：f10 六格几乎全空，只剩右下一枚握手 emoji；f12 左格的深色面板已出现 3 行（Send / Swap / Receive），中格出现绿色「✓ Backing Up」胶囊外加一圈浅绿光环，右格出现「Submitted — Pending — Completed」竖向时间线（蓝色勾点由竖线串联，右侧灰色时间戳「Oct 10 2026 · 14:4…」）；f13 面板多出第四行「Purchase (ID Required)」，Receive 的图标正处在过渡中（绿色圆片、箭头尚未出现），「Urgent ~ 20 Secs」费用卡与 emoji 头像行同时出现；f14 全部落定，计数已跳到「~ 21 Secs」。面板每行约 96px，深灰与更深灰交替，左侧 36px 彩色图标圆片 + 标题 + 一行灰色说明。
translation: 管理面板（主办人的操作面板）行式=图标圆片 + 标题 + 一行说明，深浅交替；报名→确认→签到的状态时间线照「勾点+竖线+右侧时间戳」；局详情展开后各区块按行错峰进场；局卡上的倒计时/人数可用这种原地跳字。
auditNote: Frames genuinely change: evidence f13 shows the grid with only the top row filled (Send/Swap/Receive panel, green 'Backing Up' pill with light-green halo, Submitted/Pending/Completed timeline with 'Oct 10 2026 · 14:4…' stamps) and the bottom row empty except the handshake emoji; f14 shows the fully settled grid with the fourth 'Purchase (ID Required)' row, the 'Urgent ~ 21 Secs' fee card and the emoji avatar row; the contact sheet additionally shows the counter ticking in place (~21 → ~20 → ~19 Secs) across consecutive frames, so 已看动效 is justified. Caveat: the observation's frame labels are off — evidence f10/f12 are hero scroll positions with the grid only peeking at the bottom (not 'six cells empty + handshake'), and the '~20 Secs' intermediate state exists only on the sheet; also the sheet counts down rather than up. Substantive claims (staggered fill, in-place counter) are still supported. family.co is the creator's own site; not excluded. 'ui' is acceptable since status is verified; given the title and tags lead with 动效/motion, 'motion' would equally fit. Translation names 管理面板行式, 状态时间线, 局详情区块错峰进场, 局卡倒计时跳字.

name: Things 3 — Upcoming 按日分组列表与 Headings（culturedcode.com/things/features）
creator: Cultured Code
observation: Upcoming 列表：每一天是一个分组，组头是大号日数「17」，其右以小号灰字写「Tomorrow / Thursday / Friday」，组间细线；每组先列日历事件（灰色、时间前置，如「10:00 Interview with Lydia」），再列待办（复选框行，待办下方一行浅灰的所属项目名）；「Upcoming」标题下一枚极小的「Important」胶囊。Headings（iOS）：项目内用粗体蓝色标题「Get packed」「Things to do」带「···」把待办分段，正被拖动的标题渲染为带投影的白色卡「Things to buy」。
translation: 我参加的局按日分组：组头大日数 + 小星期；同一天先排固定事件再排待办的双层密度可对应「已确认的局」在前、「待确认」在后；主办人名单的分组标题可拖动（角色分层的 Headings 写法）。
auditNote: features_s2.png shows the Upcoming list exactly as described (large day number 17/18/19 with small grey Tomorrow/Thursday/Friday, grey time-prefixed calendar events such as 10:00 Interview with Lydia, checkbox to-dos with project subtitles, tiny Important pill, hairline between groups) and the Headings iOS phone with bold blue Get packed / Things to do headings with ··· and the dragged white Things to buy card. features_s0.png confirms the culturedcode.com features page (creator's own site). Not an excluded work; static status and ui category fit; translation names concrete places (我参加的局 day grouping, confirmed-before-pending ordering, draggable host-list headings).

name: Material 3 Expressive — 「Start building」博客的 Caution/Do 形状与颜色对照
creator: Google Material Design
observation: 形状对照：Caution 图中媒体控制的三枚按钮是同尺寸圆形；Do 图里暂停钮变成约两倍宽的圆角方块，两侧次要钮仍是药丸，下方「Living room / Queue」芯片同时缩小成小胶囊。颜色对照：视频剪辑时间线里，Caution 的播放钮与选中轨「Ambient」都是中性灰；Do 里播放钮改为粉色、选中轨填充紫色、上传钮也染色。每对图下方分别压一条黄色「! Caution」与绿色「✓ Do」色带。
translation: 管理面板里主操作要同时在形状与颜色上脱离兄弟按钮：改期/取消弹层保留次要钮为同尺寸药丸，把主钮放大成圆角方块；局卡的状态芯片只给当前状态上色，其余保持中性。
auditNote: f13.png shows the shape Caution/Do pair (three same-size circles vs an enlarged rounded-square pause with smaller Living room/Queue chips) and f14.png the color pair (grey play button and grey Ambient track vs pink play, purple-filled Ambient and tinted upload button), each with yellow '! Caution' and green '✓ Do' bands; sheet.png confirms the May 13, 2025 'Start building with Material 3 Expressive' post on m3.material.io (Google's own site). Minor nit: the Do-side secondary buttons are squircles rather than strict pills, but the substance of the observation holds. Not excluded; translation names concrete places (改期/取消弹层 primary button shape, 局卡 status chip coloring).

name: 飞书日历产品页：会议室时段网格与「新建日程」浮层
creator: 飞书 / Lark（字节跳动）
observation: 桌面端截图：左侧深色侧栏；「日历 | 会议室」双页签，当前页签蓝色下划线；工具条含日期「2021年10月26日」、楼宇选择「Beijing-ChengjianAI(城建A座)·8层」、「设备」「容纳人数」筛选；主体是行=会议室（F8-12、F8-13 … F11-4，每行副文「16·电视·白板」）、列=小时（11:00–19:00）的网格，已占用时段为灰块，正在拖出的新时段为浅蓝块并标「新日程」；其上浮一张「新建日程」卡（标题输入框、日期 + 13:00–14:00 时间选择、几行灰色占位、右下「更多」「保存」）。章节标题「极速查找空闲会议室」以约 36px 置于右侧。另一屏「订阅公共日历」是带彩色复选框的列表 + 绿色块的月视图。
translation: 改期弹层旧→新对照：用一条时间行网格，新时段是灰色占用块之间的浅蓝块，上方浮出带起止时间的小卡；局的地点选择可按「行=场地、列=时段」排；中文标题约 36px 与 13px 正文的比例可作中文局名与时间的参考。
auditNote: f02.png shows the meeting-room grid precisely as described: dark left sidebar, 日历|会议室 tabs with blue underline on 会议室, toolbar with 2021年10月26日, Beijing-ChengjianAI(城建A座)·8层, 设备/容纳人数 filters, rows F8-12…F11-4 with 16·电视·白板 subtext, 11:00–19:00 columns, grey occupied blocks, light-blue 新日程 block and the floating 新建日程 card (title input, 13:00–14:00, grey placeholders, 更多/保存), with the ~36px 极速查找空闲会议室 heading on the right; sheet.png shows the 订阅公共日历 list with colored checkboxes and green-block month view. feishu.cn/product/calendar is the brand's own product page. Not excluded; translation names concrete places (改期弹层 old→new time-row grid, venue picker as rows=场地/cols=时段, Chinese heading/body ratio).

name: Airbnb 2025 Summer Release — Trips 标签的行程时间线与 Profile
creator: Airbnb
observation: Trips 标签：顶卡「Apartment in Mexico City / May 22 – 26 · Hosted by Anna」+ 地址 + 「Get directions」按钮；其下是竖向时间线，左轨放日期标记——粉色实心圆「Thu 22」（当天）与灰色描边圆「Sat 24」，两者之间一条细灰线；每个条目是白色卡：方形小缩略图 +「Check in after 3:00 PM」；「Local taqueada / 5:00 PM · By Raja」；体验卡更高，带全宽照片与「Get in the ring with a real Mexican luchador / 1:30 PM · Hosted by Retro」；底栏「Trips」高亮为红。Profile 屏：头像旁统计列「24 Trips / 22 Reviews / 8 Years on Airbnb」，下方两枚带「NEW」角标的方块「Past trips」（叠放照片）和「Connections」（叠放头像）。
translation: 我参加的局用左轨日期标记的竖向时间线，当天实心、未来描边；每条局卡以「时间 · Hosted by 谁」一行区分参加/主办；历史区入口做成「Past trips」式叠照片方块；个人页的三格统计可写「发起 N 局 / 参加 N 局 / 第 N 年」。
auditNote: f08.png shows the Trips tab as described (Apartment in Mexico City / May 22–26 · Hosted by Anna, Condesa address, Get directions, pink filled Thu 22 and grey Sat 24 day markers on a left rail, Check in after 3:00 PM, Local taqueada 5:00 PM · By Raja, the taller luchador experience card with full-width photo and 1:30 PM · Hosted by Retro, red Trips tab) and f11.png the Profile (24 Trips / 22 Reviews / 8 Years on Airbnb, Past trips and Connections tiles with NEW badges). A cookie banner covers the lower viewport but the cited UI is fully visible above it; f12.png is the Media Assets section and merely does not contradict. Minor: the connector between day markers reads as a small grey dot rather than a line. news.airbnb.com is Airbnb's own newsroom; not excluded; translation names concrete places (我参加的局 timeline with filled/outlined day markers, Past-trips-style history tile, three-stat profile row).

name: Exclusion Tabs (rauno.me/craft)
creator: Rauno Freiberg
observation: 五个文字 tab 等距排在一行，选中态是一枚黑色胶囊（高度约为文字行高的 1.8 倍，左右内边距约 14px）。点击 Press 后胶囊从 Community 滑向 Press：f00 里胶囊停在两者之间，被胶囊盖住的字母（Comm|unity 的 unity、Pr|ess 的 Pr）即刻反白、露在外面的部分仍是黑字——文字颜色由胶囊当前覆盖的像素决定，不是整词切换；f01 起胶囊已落在 Press 上，之后 7 帧（每帧 70ms）保持不动，整个滑动在约 100ms 内完成。
translation: 我的局顶部「我参加的 / 我发起的」分段切换：用一枚滑动胶囊承载选中态，文字按被覆盖像素反白而不是整词变色，切换时长控制在 100–150ms。
auditNote: still.png shows the five tabs with the black pill on Community; f00.png shows the pill mid-slide between Community and Press with 'unity' and 'Pr' inverted white while 'Comm' and 'ess' remain black (pixel-level inversion, not whole-word switch); the frames sheet shows frame 1 mid-slide and frames 2–8 settled on Press, so the interface genuinely changes between frames and 已看动效 is verified. rauno.me/craft/exclusion-tabs is the designer's own site; only Rauno Hold-to-confirm is excluded, not this piece. Category kept as ui (segmented-control/tabs pattern, consistent with how the ledger treats Rauno craft pieces), though motion would also fit given the verified animation. Translation names a concrete place (我的局 top 我参加的/我发起的 segmented switch with 100–150ms sliding pill).

name: Logo Carousel (rauno.me/craft)
creator: Rauno Freiberg
observation: 四个 logo 槽位等宽排在浅灰面板上，整组约每 2 秒轮换一次（descript/duolingo/FAIRE/Clearbit → IDEO/Khan Academy/Quizlet/ramp → canopy/Canva/casetext/STRAVA）。换组不是整行同步切换而是逐槽位错峰：f05 中第一槽 IDEO 已清晰，第二槽 duolingo 正向上模糊淡出、Khan Academy 从下方模糊进入，第三槽 Quizlet 还是半透明，第四槽仍停在旧的 Clearbit；f14 再次看到同样的从左到右错峰（descript 进、Canva/duolingo 退、casetext 已稳、STRAVA 未动）。出场元素同时做了位移 + 模糊 + 透明度三件事，入场沿相反方向进入。
translation: 我的局历史区归档或列表内容刷新：多张局卡按列错峰（每张延迟 60–80ms）做「位移 + 模糊 + 淡出」替换，而不是整列同时闪切。
auditNote: sheet.png, f05.png and f14.png genuinely show per-slot staggered blur+shift+fade transitions between logo sets (IDEO already crisp while duolingo/Khan Academy blurred and Clearbit still old; later descript entering, casetext stable, STRAVA unchanged), matching the observation. rauno.me/craft is the creator's own site; only 'Rauno Hold-to-confirm' is excluded, not Logo Carousel. Translation names a concrete surface (历史区归档/列表内容刷新).

name: Vaul — Drawer for React (官方演示)
creator: Emil Kowalski
observation: 点击 Open Drawer 后：f00 抽屉已从底部升到约视口 63% 高（顶部圆角，中央 48×4px 灰色把手），同时底层页面整体缩小（四周露出黑边，宽度约缩到 97%）并罩上深灰半透明层，原标题 Vaul 仍可见在抽屉上方；f01 抽屉升到约 94% 高，底层页面继续缩小、压暗到只剩顶部一条；f02 之后抽屉定格，背景页面只剩顶部约 10px 的深色条。抽屉内容居中列宽约 430px，正文 15px 灰字、标题 15px 黑字。背景的「缩放 + 压暗」与抽屉的「上升」是同步联动的两层。
translation: 我的局管理面板（改期 / 取消 / 转让）作为底部抽屉弹出时：背景局详情同步缩小约 3% 并压暗，让抽屉有叠在上面的层级感；顶部把手条给出可拖拽暗示。
auditNote: still.png is the untouched landing page; f00.png shows the drawer about two-thirds up with the page behind scaled (black margins) and dimmed with 'Vaul' still visible; sheet.png frames progress to the drawer near full height with only a dark top strip. Observation matches. vaul.emilkowal.ski is Emil Kowalski's own demo site, not excluded. Translation names 局管理面板（改期/取消/转让）底部抽屉.

name: Sonner — toast component (官方演示)
creator: Emil Kowalski
observation: 首屏标题 Sonner 上方画着三张堆叠的白色卡片轮廓（上层最宽、下层逐层缩窄约 5%，每层露出约 8px 边），是 toast 堆叠的静态隐喻。点击 Render a toast 后（视频 4fps）：f40 中 toast 在右下角出现，位置比最终位置低约 25px、整体半透明、文字呈浅灰；f42 升到最终位置并完全不透明，卡片约 356×72px、白底 1px 浅灰边、12px 圆角，内含加粗标题 + 灰色副文两行。进入 = 上移 + 淡入，约 0.5s。
translation: 我的局报名成功 / 撕票完成后的轻提示：白卡从下方上移淡入，副标题用灰字分层；多条提示时按「堆叠卡」隐喻逐层缩窄露边。
auditNote: still2.png shows the three stacked card outlines above the Sonner title; f40.png shows the toast lower and semi-transparent in the bottom-right, f42.png shows it risen and fully opaque with bold title + grey subtitle; sheet.png shows frames before and after the toast appears. Observation matches. sonner.emilkowal.ski is the creator's own demo. Translation names 报名成功/撕票完成后的轻提示.

name: uilabs — Elastic Card
creator: Mariana Castilho (mrncst)
observation: 静止态（rest.png）：约 300×360px 的粉色卡片，左上角橙色衬线小字「03 / Image Models」，中部是橙色抖动网点的半身像，底部贴边一条深色按钮「Connect multiple image models」（高 40px，圆角与卡片同为约 16px）。触发后（frames f00→f01）：深色底条向上长高成一块覆盖卡片下半部的面板（高度从 40px 变为约 190px），f00 中面板高度过半、内容已出现但底部被裁；f01 定格：标题 + 两行灰色说明 + 一行带头像的深灰内嵌按钮「Logged in as Mariana」+ 粉色主按钮「Authenticate to Enable」。粉色按钮沿用卡片底色，深色面板沿用按钮色，是「按钮扩展成面板」而不是弹出新层。
translation: 局卡→详情的展开的轻量版：局卡底部的「报名」条直接在卡内向上长成确认面板（身份行 + 主按钮），面板色 = 按钮色、主按钮色 = 卡底色，保持同一材质。
auditNote: rest.png shows the pink '03 Image Models' card with the dark bottom button; sheet.png frame 1 and f00.png show the dark panel mid-expansion with the 'Logged in as Mariana' row clipped at the bottom, f01.png and later frames show the full panel with the pink 'Authenticate to Enable' button. Frames change between captures, so motion is verified. uilabs.dev is Mariana Castilho's own site, not excluded. Translation names the 局卡底部「报名」条 growing into a confirm panel.

name: iOS Menu (paco.me/craft)
creator: Paco Coursey
observation: 深灰色菜单约 248px 宽，每行 44px 高、左文字右图标，行间 1px 更深的分隔线。点击带子项的 Focus 后（f00）：子项 Zen Mode、Reader Mode 从 Focus 下方以 clip-path 展开，展开过程中原本的 List 行还透过底部可见（f00 中 Reader Mode 与 List 重叠）；f01 定格：父级行 New Space 整体压暗（文字变灰、背景略浅），Focus 行左侧出现 ⌄ 折角图标，子项两行保持全亮。嵌套展开发生在原位，父层通过「文字比背景压得更暗」的两级变暗退后。
translation: 局管理 sheet 的二级操作（改期 → 选新时间 / 取消 → 选原因）在原位向下展开而不是跳新页；展开时上层选项压暗（文字变灰幅度大于背景），保留当前位置感。
auditNote: still.png shows the collapsed menu (New Space / Focus › / Heading 1 / List); f00 is a genuine mid-expansion frame where Reader Mode overlaps the still-visible List row and the Focus chevron is mid-rotation; f01 is the settled state with New Space dimmed (grey text, lighter bg), ⌄ on Focus, Zen Mode / Reader Mode fully lit. sheet.png (8 frames) confirms the interface changes between frames, so 已看动效 is justified. Page text on paco.me itself confirms clip-path reveal and the two-rate text/background dimming. URL is Paco Coursey's own site (original). Not excluded. Translation names the 局管理 sheet's second-level actions. Minor nit: in the 1280x900 capture the menu is 248px wide as stated but rows measure ~52px, not 44px.

name: Awwwards Conferences 网站（案例页）

name: The Ways We Work (Miro) — 编辑型网站（案例页）
creator: Obys Agency

auditNote: Both captures show the Obys case page: left column with only project name / Technology, Web Design/Dev / underlined Live Website; black frame containing the site hero (off-white, dark-blue rounded 'The Ways We Work' bottom-left, collage with yellow circle, blue building, pink cloud top-right); below, two report cards — 'Collaboration is the new watercooler' with two-column small text, and the right card with 50 / 44 / 36 / 40 stacked large numbers, small % at upper right, grey caption, small index text and thin rule at the card's top-left. obys.agency/work/... is the agency's own case page (original). name: iOS App Store: Layout animation（Motion 官方示例）
creator: Motion（Matt Perry）/ motion.dev examples
observation: 在 390×844 移动视口点击『Capture the Night…』卡片：f00（点击后约120ms）卡片已从两列网格中的半宽卡放大到约 86% 视口宽（左缘贴 0，右缘约 668/780），圆角仍保留，正文两段已经在图片下方出现并与图片底部重叠，其余三张卡被压暗成灰阶留在底层；f02（约360ms）卡片铺满全宽，头图从 330px 高拉到约 560px（y 325→890），正文块下移到图片之外并加大内边距；f04–f07 停住：标题『Today』与头像变灰退后，整个过程中封面图、分类小字与标题是同一对象持续放大位移，没有淡入替换。
translation: 局卡→详情的展开：局卡封面与中文局名作为同一图层连续放大到全宽，详情正文从卡片底部『长出来』而不是另开页面；列表里其它局卡压暗留在底层作为返回线索。
auditNote: Official motion.dev example page (fetched title: 'iOS App Store: Layout animation example & tutorial for JavaScript | Motion'). appstore.png probe shows the 2-column grid start state with the 'Capture the Night' card at half width; f00.png shows the card mid-expansion at ~86% viewport width (right edge ~668/780), body text overlapping the image bottom, other three cards dimmed to grey; f02.png shows full width with the hero stretched to ~y890 and the body block moved below. Frames genuinely change, so 已看动效 holds and category motion is correct. Not in the excluded list (distinct from iOS 18 zoom transition Bracelets). Translation names 局卡→详情 shared-layer expansion concretely.

name: Family-style dialog（Motion 官方示例）
creator: Motion（Matt Perry）/ motion.dev examples
observation: 点击底部通栏薄荷绿『Receive』胶囊按钮，以 20ms 间隔连拍：f00 对话框容器高度只到最终的约 75%，标题『Confirm』和说明文字已就位但透明度偏低，而『Receive』按钮仍是原来那条宽胶囊的形状、停在右下、宽度正在从通栏收缩到半宽，左侧『Cancel』位置只有一块暗底还没有文字；f01（约100ms后）容器到达最终高度（约占视口底部 220/844），按钮并排分成『Cancel』『Receive』各占一半，之后 f02–f07 完全静止。按钮是从页面上原有的那颗按钮变形进对话框，而不是对话框从空白淡入。
translation: 管理弹层（改期／取消／取消报名）的唤起：让局详情底部的主按钮本身长成确认卡，按钮位置保持连续，第二个『取消』动作从它旁边分裂出来，避免弹层与触发按钮脱节。
auditNote: Official motion.dev example (fetched title: 'Family-style dialog example for React | Motion'). family-dialog.png probe shows the full-width mint 'Receive' pill start state; f00.png shows the dialog at partial height with 'Confirm' title/body slightly dimmed, the 'Receive' pill still wide and sitting bottom-right mid-shrink, and a textless dark block at bottom-left where 'Cancel' will land; sheet.png frames 2-8 show the settled two-button layout. The button-to-dialog morph is genuinely visible across frames, so 已看动效 and category motion are correct. Not excluded. Translation names the 管理弹层（改期/取消/取消报名）唤起 concretely.

name: Sheet Modal（Motion 官方示例）
creator: Motion（Matt Perry）/ motion.dev examples
observation: 点击页面中央的『Share』按钮：f00（+120ms）底部面板只升起到顶缘 y≈965/1688，底部的『Save to Files』一行被视口裁掉，面板顶部有一条 80px 宽的灰色拖拽把手、右上角圆形关闭钮，而背景里的『Share』按钮仍是全亮度；f01（+240ms）面板顶缘到达 y≈850 并停住，面板上缘压在『Share』按钮的下半截上，按钮被半透明遮罩压暗；f02–f07 静止。面板内容在上升过程中就已完整排版（标题『Share』、四个头像、分隔线、四行动作），没有内容滞后淡入；上升路径只有位移，没有缩放。
translation: 局管理底部面板（成员名单／改期／取消）的弹出节奏：面板一出现内容就排好版，整体做一次位移上升并在约 250ms 内停住；背景只压暗不缩放，拖拽把手宽度约为面板宽度的 1/5。
auditNote: Official motion.dev example (fetched title: 'Sheet Modal example for React | Motion'). f00.png shows the sheet partway up (top ≈965/1688, 'Save to Files' clipped, 80px drag handle, round close button, 'Share' button at full brightness); f01.png/f03.png show it settled at ≈850 overlapping the lower half of the dimmed 'Share' button; sheet.png confirms frames 3-8 static. Content is fully laid out in every frame, width unchanged (translate only). Genuine inter-frame change, so 已看动效 and motion are correct. Not excluded; translation names 局管理底部面板 concretely. Minor correction for the author: the translation's '把手宽度约为面板宽度的 1/5' is off — 80px on a ~746px sheet is ~1/9; the observation's '80px' figure is accurate.

name: Pokopia: Modal（Motion 官方示例）
creator: Motion（Matt Perry）/ motion.dev examples
observation: 页面载入后以 150ms 间隔连拍：f00–f01 全黑；f02 背景出现一张被高斯模糊的游戏场景图，画面正中只有一个约 300×300 的红色圆角方块（白描边，中心一枚精灵球图标）；f03 这个红方块已经放大成几乎占满视口的竖向弹层（红色外框约 60px 厚、内部白色面板、外侧还有一圈白描边），精灵球图标消失；f04–f07 静止。弹层是从一个图标大小的红色『种子』按比例长出来的，边框厚度与圆角在放大过程中保持视觉一致，背景模糊在弹层出现前先到位。
translation: 局详情里的『核销／签到』弹层可以从票面角上的局徽章长出来：先模糊背景，再让一个徽章大小的色块放大成整张面板；红色厚边框＋白描边的游戏感可用于『成局』『到场』这类庆祝态面板。
auditNote: Evidence verified: sheet.png shows f00–f01 black, f02 a blurred game scene with a ~300px red rounded square carrying a Pokéball icon, f03–f07 the full-height red-bordered white panel (f02.png and _probe/pokopia.png confirm both end states). Frames genuinely change, so 已看动效 holds. motion.dev/examples/react-pokopia-modal returned 200 and is the Motion library's own example page (original source). Not on the excluded list. Observation is concrete (sizes, frame-by-frame states); translation names specific places in 我的局 (局详情 核销/签到 弹层, 成局/到场 庆祝态面板).

name: Events app – tickets & payment animation
creator: Kohut Piotr for 10Clouds（设计师本人 Dribbble 上传）
observation: Shot 视频以 600ms 间隔抽 8 帧：f00 是深色活动详情（大图上压『URBAN ZOO』、日期『14 June 2017』、『Add to calendar』按钮）；f01 一块黄色面板从底部升起盖住下半屏，标题『URBAN ZOO』被顶到面板上沿之上，面板内每种票是一张白色小票：左右两侧各切出半圆缺口（撕票线），左侧是『0 ×』『1 ×』数量滚轮，上下露出半透明的相邻数字；f02–f03 数量从 1 滚到 2；f04–f05 面板内容换成银行卡（VISA、四组卡号、持卡人、04/24）和『Your receipt』小票（Standard 2 €25 / Balcony 2 €39）；f06 是八个支付方式的 logo 网格；f07 是卡号数字键盘。整个流程始终在同一块黄色面板内换内容，面板本身不离开。
translation: 票根与报名流程：局详情下方升起一块有色面板，票以『两侧带半圆缺口的小票』呈现；人数选择用上下露出邻位数字的滚轮；『付款／确认』步骤在同一面板里换内容，而不是跳页。
auditNote: play/sheet.png shows eight distinct frames of the shot playing on the Dribbble page: dark 'URBAN ZOO' detail with 14 June 2017 and Add-to-calendar (f00), yellow panel rising with perforated white ticket rows and 0×/1× number rollers (f01, confirmed by f01.png), quantity rolling to 2 (f03), VISA card + receipt (f04–f05), payment-logo grid (f06), card-number keypad (f07). Frames change, so 已看动效 holds. URL is the designer's own upload (Kohut Piotr for 10Clouds) on Dribbble, which the rubric allows; page resolved (202, not a challenge page — shot and byline visible). Not excluded. Translation names concrete 我的局 places (局详情下方有色面板, 人数滚轮, 付款/确认 in-panel step).

name: Ticket Animation（Knife and Fox）
creator: Zac Bistline for Knife and Fox（设计师本人 Dribbble 上传）
observation: Shot 视频以 600ms 间隔抽 8 帧：f00–f01 顶部是叠在一起的三张票，最上面是登机牌『SEA ✈ JFK』，下方列表依次是 Flight（LAX → John Wayne）、Hotel；f02–f03 顶部换成金色丽思卡尔顿酒店卡（Suite / Emily Berg / 01/22/16–01/25/16），列表第一行同步变成 Hotel；f04–f05 顶部换成电影票『The Hateful Eight』，列表第一行变成 Movie；f06 整张卡出现明显运动模糊，f07 画面只剩灰色底。票堆每张票只露出上沿约 20px 作为层叠线索，当前票的边缘有撕票锯齿，顶部卡片切换时下方列表的首行同步重排，两者是同一次切换。

auditNote: play/sheet.png shows the stacked ticket swapping across frames: SEA✈JFK boarding pass with Flight/Hotel list (f00–f01), gold Ritz-Carlton card with list first row Hotel Ritz Carlton (f02–f03, confirmed by f02.png showing Suite / Emily Berg / 01/22/16–01/25/16), The Hateful Eight movie ticket with Movie row (f04–f05), motion-blurred card (f06), grey end frame (f07). Frames change, so 已看动效 holds. URL is the designer's own Dribbble upload (Zac Bistline for Knife and Fox); page resolved with shot and byline visible. Not excluded. Translation names a concrete place ('我加入的局' 票夹 with stacked tickets and synced list row).

name: The Magic of Clip Path — Theme switch 演示
creator: Emil Kowalski（个人站 emilkowal.ski）
observation: 点击演示卡里的『Switch theme』按钮，以 60ms 间隔连拍：f00 卡片仍是浅色，只在顶缘出现一条约 2px 的深色线；f01 深色图层从顶部向下露出约 35px（刚盖住标题的上半截，标题文字因此被裁成上深下浅两截）；f02 深色已盖到约 85%，只剩按钮下方一条浅色；f03 整张卡变成深色、按钮翻成白底黑字，之后静止。页面同时给出实现：`clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0)` → `inset(0 0 0 0)`，1s，cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1)。深色版是叠在原卡上的一份复制，文字位置完全不动，只有裁切边在走。
translation: 票根撕票／核销后的票面换态：『已核销』『已改期』的新票面作为一层复制叠在原票上，用裁切边从撕票线向下扫过露出，局名、时间等文字位置保持不动，只有一条边在移动。
auditNote: theme/sheet.png shows the demo card progressing: light card with a thin dark line at the top edge (f00), dark layer ~35px down slicing the heading (f01, confirmed by f01.png where the title is cut into dark/light halves), dark covering ~85% with a light strip below the button (f02), fully dark with white button (f03–f07). The page also displays the stated code (clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0)→inset(0 0 0 0), 1s, cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1)). Frames change, so 已看动效 holds. URL is Emil Kowalski's personal site (original source); resolved 200 on retry. Not excluded. Translation names a concrete place (票根 核销/改期 state change swept from the perforation line with text fixed).

name: Success Tick for Housy（Rive 社区文件）
creator: akshaysharmaw（Rive community 作者页）
observation: 文件页自动播放，以 300ms 间隔连拍：粉色画布上是一团由 6–8 个半透明蓝色圆重叠出来的『团块』，中央一枚珊瑚红粗对勾。f00 团块整体偏向左上、右下露出淡蓝残影；f02–f03 团块向右移动、残影换到左侧；f04–f07 继续小幅漂移。对勾本身在所有帧里位置和角度不变，只有背后那组圆在做缓慢的相位漂移，残影由透明度递减的同心圆叠出，没有描边。
translation: 签到／出席确认的成功态：对勾静止不动，背后的色团用多层半透明圆做缓慢漂移，给『已确认』一个持续但不抢戏的活体感，可用于到场打卡后的票根印章。
auditNote: Sheet (8 tiles) and f00 show the Rive community file page 'Success Tick for Housy' by akshaysharmaw (9 August 2021, CC BY). Visible: pink canvas, cluster of overlapping translucent blue circles, fixed coral checkmark; across tiles the blob's offset and the residual circles shift sides (tile 1 blob left with residual right, tiles 2–3 shifted right with residual left) while the tick stays put — genuine inter-frame change, matches the observation. URL is the creator's own upload on rive.app community (equivalent to a designer's own Dribbble upload), not an aggregator. Not on the excluded list. Translation names concrete places (签到／出席确认成功态, 到场打卡后的票根印章).

name: !Boring Software 官网（滚动叙事）
creator: Not Boring Software（Andy Allen）
observation: 录屏滚动 10 秒按 1fps 抽帧：f00 只有导航和空白，f01 出现紫色『!BORING』大字；f02–f03 灰底区块里只有『Playful software for life's boring routines.』和一行『Most apps help you save time.』，f06–f08 同一区块多出第二行『We help you savor it 😊』——文案是分行按滚动进度追加的；f06 到 f07 『Let's Play』下的三个 App 图标从左到右依次入场（f06 第一个图标只露出一半），f08 三个图标到位；再往下 f09–f10 出现线框 3D 球体，f14–f15 出现超大 3D 数字。页面没有一次性铺满内容，每个区块都留出整屏空白等滚动到位再出现。
translation: 历史区／归档区的构图：已结束的局按滚动进度逐段出现，每个月份区块先出标题再追加说明行；局卡以左到右的错峰入场而不是整屏同时淡入。
auditNote: scroll-sheet.png (16 tiles) plus f04/f08/f12 show notboring.software at distinct scroll states: nav+blank, grey block with only 'Most apps help you save time.', later the same block with 'We help you savor it 😊' appended, purple !BORING hero, 'Let's Play' with one tile where the leftmost app icon is only partly visible while the other two are in place, then the wireframe 3D sphere and the oversized 3D digits. Interface clearly changes between frames, so 已看动效 holds and motion category fits. Caveats: the observation's frame indices do not line up with the sheet (e.g. !BORING is at tile 5, not f01; the sphere at tiles 11–12, not f09–f10), and the 'left-to-right' entry order is ambiguous since the leftmost icon is the one still entering — the stagger itself is real. Studio's own site; not excluded; translation names 历史区／归档区 and 局卡.

name: Boarding Pass Scroll-up
creator: Helen Zhou（设计师本人 Dribbble 上传）
observation: Shot 动图以 600ms 间隔抽 8 帧：画面是斜放的手机上一张白色登机牌（DELTA，PEK→SFO，DL0128，Gate A25 T3，登机时间 07:45PM 用红色超大字）。f00 在出发地『PEK』右上方贴着一枚红色圆角胶囊『DELAYED』，旁边有小字『1h 15m』；f01 同一位置胶囊消失只剩一个红点；f05 胶囊再次出现。其余版式（航班号、条形码、登机区『3』）在所有帧里完全不动，状态变化只靠这一枚贴在地点码旁边的红色标签在原位弹出/收回表达。

name: three.js example — Ammo.js softbody cloth（physics_ammo_cloth）
creator: three.js（mrdoob 与贡献者，官方示例）
period: 2018→（three.js 官方示例，当前版本在线）
observation: f00（静止）：一块约 40×30 格网的白布挂在横臂下，下摆搭在彩色砖墙顶部，布面有两道从挂点垂下的大褶皱和若干小皱纹；连按 Q 转动横臂后 f01 横臂已转约 60°，布被拉离墙面，布面被拉直成一条斜向的紧绷带，褶皱集中到两侧；f02 横臂转到约 120°，布悬空垂挂、下摆向左甩出；f03 横臂接近 180°，布整体飘到立柱后方、下摆呈甩动的弧形；f04 以后横臂继续转动，布离开画面。布的位移总是滞后于横臂：先是挂点被拉动，褶皱再沿布面传播到下摆，静止前有一次甩动回摆；地面投影随之同步变形。
translation: 我的局「票根撕票」后的票面坠落、以及把「已取消的局」从列表拖走时：物体与牵引点的滞后关系（先动挂点、再传到下摆）可作为卡片被拖走时的形变规则——顶部先走、底部拖尾并回摆一次再静止。
auditNote: f00 shows the official three.js 'Ammo.js physics soft body cloth demo' (caption 'Press Q or A to move the arm') with the cloth hanging from the arm against the brick wall; f01 shows the arm rotated and the cloth pulled taut into a narrow cone; f03 shows the arm near edge-on with the cloth swinging behind the post and its shadow on the ground; the 8-tile sheet continues until the cloth exits frame left. Matches the observation (lagging drape, shadow deforming). URL is threejs.org's own example page (project/creator source, not an aggregator). Not excluded. Translation names concrete places (票根撕票后的票面坠落, 已取消的局被拖走时的卡片形变).

name: Folding the DOM — 3D 折纸式图片展开演示
creator: Josh W. Comeau
observation: 演示区是一张竖幅霓虹照片，被横向切成上下两半，滑块「Folded Percentage」控制下半片绕中线折起的角度。逐步按 PageDown（每帧 −10%）：f00（65%）下半片折起并盖住上半片下沿，看到的是它的背面——一片半透明的白色薄面，透出照片，透视使它上宽下窄；f01（55%）下半片接近与视线齐平，压成一条高约 60px 的白色扁梯形，上半片几乎完整露出；f02（45%）越过水平线后看到的是正面照片本身、因透视上宽下窄且略暗；f03（35%）→f06（5%）下半片逐渐放平、宽度向上半片对齐；f07（0%）两半严丝合缝成一张平整照片。折痕处没有阴影，厚度感只靠「背面白色薄面」与透视缩放表达。
translation: 我的局「局卡→详情的展开」与「票根」的正反面：局卡展开成详情时可把卡片下半当作沿中缝折起的纸面——先露出一个半透明的背面薄片、越过水平线后才显示详情内容；票根翻看二维码也可沿用同一个「背面＝半透明白片」的材质约定。
auditNote: Sheet (8 tiles, slider 65→55→45→35→25→15→5→0) and f00/f01/f07 show joshwcomeau.com/react/folding-the-dom/ with the neon photo demo: at 65% the lower half is folded up showing a translucent white backface; at 55% it is nearly edge-on as a thin white trapezoid; at 45% and below the front of the photo is visible and widens until at 0% the image is flat and seamless. Frames genuinely differ, supporting the observation. Author's own site. The excluded item is the Josh Comeau shadows article, a different work; this one is not excluded. Translation names concrete places (局卡→详情的展开, 票根正反面).

name: BookBlock — A Content Flip Plugin（Demo 1）
creator: Mary Lou（Manoela Ilic），Codrops
observation: （演示原址 tympanus.net/Development/BookBlock/ 在本网络不可达，本次从作者仓库克隆后本地运行截图。）一张约 400×300 的插画「书页」，底部四个翻页按钮。点击 next 后每 110ms 一帧：f00 第一页（橙底大象）完整平铺；f01 翻页进行中——页面从左右中线处被折起，左半是第一页的右半正在立起、右半已露出第二页左半，中缝处是一条约 25px 宽、带深棕渐变的立起页边，页边顶端比页面顶边高出约 20px（透视），新页右侧有一条浅灰阴影；f02 起第二页（棕色大象）完全平铺、页边阴影消失。整个翻动约 1 秒，中间只有一两帧能看到「立起的页边」，翻页的厚度感全靠那条带渐变的竖条和顶端凸出。
translation: 我的局「历史区的归档构图」与「我发起的／我参加的」切换：把两组局列表当作同一本册子的前后页，用中缝立起的渐变页边表达翻页；票根查看「上一张／下一张」时也可用这种中轴翻页而不是左右平移。
auditNote: Evidence matches: f00 shows page 1 (orange/grey elephant) flat, f01 shows a mid-flip with a ~25px dark-brown gradient spine strip at the centre fold whose top protrudes above the page edge and a light shadow on the new page, f02 shows page 2 (brown elephant) flat; sheet rows confirm the flip resolves and holds. Source is Codrops' own repo (github.com/codrops/BookBlock, created 2012-09-03 per GitHub, local clone origin codrops/BookBlock); not excluded; observation is concrete; translation names 历史区归档/我发起的·我参加的 and 票根上一张下一张. Minor: GitHub reports pushed_at 2017-05-28 while the clone's last commit is 2016-01-12, so '仓库最后更新 2016-01' is slightly off.

name: Card Stack Effects（Yuda / Krisna 演示）
creator: Mary Lou（Manoela Ilic），Codrops
observation: （演示原址 tympanus.net/Development/CardStackEffects/ 不可达，本次从作者仓库本地运行。）一叠约 6 张的方卡（每张比上一张向上偏 4px、露出彩色边）配一对「×／✓」按钮。点击 ✓ 后每 120ms 一帧：f00 顶卡已脱离牌叠向下方滑出并带约 10° 旋转、透明度降到约 50%，同时背景从黄变绿——绿色以一个从左上角长出的圆形扩散（f00 里圆的半径约为面板的 70%，右下角仍是黄色），牌叠第二张正往上顶替到顶位；f01 圆已铺满、顶卡消失、新顶卡就位；f02–f07 面板回到黄底（绿只是「接受」的一次闪色），牌叠保持排列。右侧 Krisna 版在左侧点击时完全不动。节奏上「卡离开」与「背景扩圆」同时开始，卡先消失、圆后铺满。
translation: 我的局「名单」里逐个处理报名（通过／拒绝）或「改期弹层旧→新对照」里旧卡退场：顶卡滑出并半透明化、下一张顶上，用一个从角落扩散的色圆作为一次性的结果反馈，而不是弹 toast。
auditNote: Evidence matches the mechanism: f00 shows the top card slid down, rotated ~10° and semi-transparent while a green circle is mid-expansion and the next card moves up; f01 shows full green with the new top card in place; sheet frames 3-8 return to yellow; the right-hand Krisna stack never moves. Source is Codrops' own repo (github.com/codrops/CardStackEffects, created 2015-10-28, clone commit by Manoela Ilic); not excluded; translation names 名单 报名通过/拒绝 and 改期弹层旧→新. MUST FIX one detail: in f00 the yellow remains in the TOP-LEFT and TOP-RIGHT corners and the green circle grows from the ✓ button at the bottom-centre of the panel, not 'from the top-left corner with yellow left bottom-right'; the translation's '从角落扩散的色圆' should read '从按钮位置扩散的色圆'.

name: Tearable Cloth（ES2015 重写版）
creator: dissimulate（@abro_oks）
observation: （原发布于 CodePen，本网络被 Cloudflare 拦截；本次用作者仓库的 Cloth.js 本地运行。）一块 54×32 格、格距 8px 的线框布由顶边固定悬挂。鼠标从布上半部向下拖（5 步、每步 200ms）：f00 布是整齐的矩形网格；f01 拖点把布向下拉出一个倒 V 形尖囊，囊底的格子被拉成两条紧贴的平行线，囊中央撕开一个约 100×150px 的洞，洞缘是一圈拉长、歪斜的四边形而不是直线；f02–f03 洞继续扩大，撕下的碎片（三五格的小网片）和单根线段脱离主体、在画面下方自由下落；f04–f06 拉力消失后布回弹成一条下垂的 U 形，两侧各留一条拉长的「撕边」挂带；f07 碎片基本落出画面，布停在 U 形。撕裂按单根约束超过阈值即断开，所以撕边总是参差的锯齿而非平滑曲线。
translation: 我的局「票根撕票」：撕开处不用直线裁切，而是沿虚线每隔一格判断「断开」，让撕边呈参差锯齿；撕下的副券以小碎片形式下落后消失；撕完主票回弹一次再静止。
auditNote: Evidence matches: f00 is an intact 54-column wireframe grid; f01 shows the inverted-V pocket pulled down with a hole torn open, jagged quad edges, and small fragments falling below; f03 shows the hole enlarged with hanging torn strips and more fragments; sheet frames 5-8 show the rebound to a sagging U with fragments drifting out. Source is the author's own repo (github.com/dissimulate/Tearable-Cloth, created 2013-11-21; the repo's index.html links to Dissimulate/Tearable-Cloth and @abro_oks); not excluded; translation names 票根撕票 with concrete behaviour. Minor correction: Cloth.js constants are clothX=54, clothY=28, spacing=8, tearDist=60, so '54×32 格' should be 54×28 (rows appear taller in the screenshot because gravity stretches the Verlet constraints).

name: Ticket loading（Rive 社区文件）
creator: WinnieQ（Rive Marketplace 上传者）
observation: 画面是一条深灰色出票口横杆（宽约 280px、两端圆头），下方一张白票带条码和「2023 YEAR-END RECOLLECTION」。每 400ms 一帧：f00 票整张在外但整体压暗（约 40% 灰），像「上一张未取走」；f01 票从杆下只露出约 1/4 高度，票的上缘被横杆遮住、条码被截断；f02–f03 票面全部露出且变纯白，底边两角圆角；f04 回到只露出约 8px 的白边（新一张开始出票）；f05 露出一半（条码上半可见、文字只剩上半）；f06 全出；f07 再回到一半。票是从横杆后方「向下长出」的——出票口在上、票向下推出，露出的永远是票的上半，被遮住的是下半。
translation: 我的局报名成功后的「票根打印」：出票口放在票上方、票被一条横杆遮挡着向下推出，上半先出现；已出过的旧票用压暗表示、新票以纯白区分；一次出票分 3–4 个停顿（露边、半张、整张）。
auditNote: Evidence is the live Rive marketplace page (uploader WinnieQ, 15 November 2023, CC BY) and the frames genuinely change: f00 full ticket dimmed grey, f01 ~1/4 of the ticket showing below the bar with the barcode truncated, f03 full white ticket with rounded bottom corners, sheet frame 5 a thin white sliver, frame 6 about half. URL is the uploader's own marketplace page (equivalent to a designer's own Dribbble upload), fetched live with matching username and date; not excluded; translation names 报名成功后的票根打印 with concrete staging. MUST FIX one claim that the images contradict: what emerges below the bar is the ticket's LOWER part (rounded bottom edge and the 'RECOLLECTION' line appear first; the top edge and the '2023YEAR-END' line stay hidden behind the bar), so '露出的永远是票的上半' and the translation's '上半先出现' are inverted and f05's '条码上半可见、文字只剩上半' should be lower barcode/lower line visible.

name: Card Shuffle（Rive 社区文件）
creator: cwthrs（Rive Marketplace 上传者）
observation: 五张白底红字「HOOK」的扑克牌，边缘带约 3px 粉色描边与圆角。每 400ms 一帧：f00 五张完全叠成一张（只在右下露出一点错位的角）；f01 牌向左以共同的右下角为支点扇开，相邻两张夹角约 12°、总张角约 50°，最左一张转得最多；f02 收拢到只剩三张可见的半扇；f03–f04 再次扇开、角度与 f01 相同；f05 完全收拢；f06 扇开；f07 收拢。扇开与收拢各约 400ms；旋转中心在牌的右下角而不是中心，所以牌头画的是圆弧轨迹；每张牌保持整张可见（不裁切），靠层级遮挡表达厚度。
translation: 我的局同一天多场局／多张票根的「局卡堆叠」：以右下角为支点扇开查看，相邻卡夹角约 12°，收起时回到同一张的外形；也可用于「名单的角色分层」把同一角色的头像作为一叠扇开。
auditNote: Evidence is the live Rive marketplace page (uploader cwthrs, 1 February 2024, CC BY, 'A stack of playing cards that shuffle in a loop') and the frames genuinely change: f00 five cards fully stacked with offset corners, f01 fanned leftward about a pivot near the bottom-right with ~12° between neighbours, f02 partially collapsed, and the sheet alternates stacked/fanned exactly as described for f03-f07. URL is the uploader's own marketplace page, fetched live with matching username and date; not excluded; translation names 局卡堆叠 (same-day multiple 局/票根) and 名单角色分层. Minor: f02 shows four cards visible rather than 'three'.

name: Printing（Rive 社区文件）
creator: ekasetiawans（Rive Marketplace 上传者）
observation: 一台蓝灰色扁平打印机（上盖带绿色指示灯、前方一条深色出纸槽）。每 400ms 一帧：f00 一张已打印的纸（灰色文字条＋一个灰色图块）从前槽完全推出，纸的顶边仍被槽口压着；f01 上方进纸口升起一张白纸、前槽的纸只剩下半截；f02 上方白纸升到最高（整张露在机身后方）、前槽只剩一小段；f03 上方白纸完整、前方无纸；f04–f05 前槽再次推出整张打印好的纸；f06 上下同时有纸；f07 前槽纸只出一半。进纸（白纸从机身后升起再沉入机身）与出纸（带内容的纸从前槽向下推出）是两个错开约半个周期的动作，内容只出现在「出纸」那张上，白纸始终空白。
translation: 我的局「票根打印」：把出票分成「空白纸进入」与「带内容的票推出」两个错开的阶段，票面内容只在推出的那张上出现；出纸槽是一条压在票顶边的深色横条，保证票从被遮挡到完整露出的层级关系清晰。
auditNote: Evidence (sheet + f00/f01/f03) shows the Rive Marketplace page 'Printing' by ekasetiawans dated 8 November 2021, with 8 genuinely different frames: a blank sheet rising from the rear feed (f01→f03) while the printed sheet retracts into the front slot, then the printed sheet re-emerging (f04–f07), with the two motions offset by about half a cycle and content only on the front sheet, exactly as observed. f03's 'no paper in front' is a hair off (a thin white sliver is visible at the slot) but immaterial. URL is the creator's own Rive upload page (first-party, not an aggregator); not the excluded Wanda Rive receipt printer. Translation names a concrete place (我的局「票根打印」). Motion category with verified 已看动效 is correct.

name: FigJam-like Stamp Tool – Radial Menu, Stamp Spawner Script（Rive 社区文件）
creator: nickyinprogress（Rive Marketplace 上传者）
observation: 一块点阵背景的白板，上面贴着带白描边的 emoji 贴纸和几张便利贴，左下有「垃圾桶／盖章」两个按钮。每 200ms 点击一次、每次向右移 25px：f00 第一次点击处（左上角）出现一枚带白色描边的绿色「👍」贴纸，约 40px 见方；f07 同一行出现 8 枚 👍，彼此部分重叠，后盖的在上层，每枚都有约 ±8° 的随机倾斜，描边交叠处白边清晰可见；右侧面板的 cursorPosX 从 183 递增到 557，证明贴纸落点跟随点击位置。贴纸是瞬时出现（相邻帧间没有缩放过渡），用「随机倾斜＋白描边＋后者压前者」表达一枚枚盖上去的实物感。
translation: 我的局「到场签到」的盖章：到场的人在名单上盖一枚带白描边、略带随机倾斜的章；多人到场时后盖的压在先盖的上面而不是整齐排列；章的落点跟随点击位置（例如盖在头像右下）。

Frames genuinely change (stamps accumulate), so 已看动效 holds; the observation honestly notes the spawn is instantaneous. URL is the creator's own upload page; not excluded. Translation names a concrete place (「到场签到」的盖章 on the roster). Category motion is acceptable since status is verified.

name: Receipt Animation（LottieFiles 作者上传页）
creator: Jaehan Park（LottieFiles）
period: n.d.（LottieFiles 免费动画页，未标日期）
observation: 一个浅灰色圆角「封套」方块（约 130×130px）和一张珊瑚红的收据方块（带白色「₩」符号和两行白色横线）。每 300ms 一帧：f00 红色收据从封套右下方斜向露出约 70%，封套压在它的左上方；f01 收据完全滑出并盖在封套前面，₩ 左上角出现一粒黄色小火花；f02 收据静止；f03 火花换位置；f04 收据退回封套后方只露出右下角；f05 露出一半；f06–f07 再次完全滑出并带火花。收据沿封套对角线（左上→右下）进出，进入时它在封套「后面」、出来后在封套「前面」，中途有一次层级交换。
translation: 我的局「票根」从「局卡」里抽出的动效：票沿卡片对角线抽出，抽出前在卡片下层、抽出完成后翻到上层；局卡充当封套，完成后在票角给一个小火花表示「可用」。
auditNote: Evidence shows the LottieFiles page 'Receipt' by Jaehan Park with 8 distinct frames: f00/f04/f05 the coral ₩ receipt sits behind the grey envelope (envelope overlaps its upper-left), f01–f03 and f06–f07 it is fully out and layered in front of the envelope, with a yellow spark at the upper-left of ₩ in f01 and yellow sparks/diagonal flick in f07; a cropped check of the sheet confirms the diagonal slide and the behind→front layer swap. Minor: f06 shows lines being redrawn rather than a visible spark, and f03 shows the ₩ mid-redraw with a white dot, but the core mechanism in the observation is supported. name: Helmut Lang Spring 1998（Vogue Runway 秀页）
creator: Helmut Lang
period: 1997-10 纽约 SS98（Vogue Runway 存档页 2016-03-22，2026-10 访问）
observation: 标题块「HELMUT LANG / SPRING 1998 READY-TO-WEAR / By Helmut Lang」，Laird Borrelli-Persson 署名，正文只有一段约 7 行（提到 Rothko 蓝到知更鸟蛋蓝、折纸般的条带、平底中式布鞋、花苞状腰包）。视口里看到 6 个看次：01 黑开衫 + 白背心 + 黑裙，白背心下摆是毛边的一道白；02 黑长开衫 + 白 T + 黑皮裙 + 黑布鞋；03 黑西装 + 白 T + 黑腰带，白 T 只露出一条横带；04 男装黑大衣 + 白 T；05 白衬衫；06 白衬衫 + 黑裤。场地是过曝的白色工作室（白墙、浅地面），人物边缘几乎与背景融合。所有看次都是窄而长、贴身而平的轮廓，颜色只有黑与白，而且黑与黑之间总夹着一条白（背心、T 恤、衬衫领）——一道白线组织了整套的层次；没有装饰、没有图案，差异只在白线的宽度与位置。

name: Ann Demeulemeester Spring 2014（Ann 本人任内最后一季；Vogue Runway 秀页）
creator: Ann Demeulemeester
period: 2013-09-25 巴黎 SS14（Vogue Runway 存档，2026-10 访问）
observation: 标题块「ANN DEMEULEMEESTER / SPRING 2014 READY-TO-WEAR / By Ann Demeulemeester」，Tim Blanks 署名，正文开头专写邀请函：“一个昂贵的信封，没有地址，秀的细节印在信封的内翻口上，完全向内（Totally interior）”。看次 01–03 共享同一顶巨型黑色薄纱宽檐帽：帽檐像一层半透明的面纱垂到眼睛以下，占画面上三分之一；01 黑色透视西装外套 + 黑短裤、腰间垂下两条及膝的黑丝带、黑色绑带靴；02 黑白印花无袖长衫，一侧有斜向的黑白条纹拼片，下接黑裤；03 黑色长外套敞开，露出米黑花纹紧身裤。T 台是黑色，观众在两侧成排。结构上每个看次都是“上重下轻”：帽子 + 外套在上半形成一个黑色块，细腿与丝带在下半拉出线条；黑纱遮脸把身份藏在半透明之后。
translation: 局卡→详情的展开：“信封内翻口”逻辑——局卡封面只有局名与时间，地址、门牌、联系方式印在翻开/展开后的内侧（卡片翻面或向下拉开），详情“向内”而不是在封面堆信息；名单的角色分层：未确认/待审核成员用半透明黑纱式遮罩盖住头像上半，确认后揭开；票根撕票：撕下后在票根处留两条细丝带状的残边（而非锯齿）；局卡构图上重下轻——顶部一块实色（封面图/标题），底部用细线（时间、人数）收束。
auditNote: Both screenshots show the genuine Vogue Runway page: ANN DEMEULEMEESTER / SPRING 2014 READY-TO-WEAR lockup, Tim Blanks byline September 25, 2013, the opening passage about the expensive envelope with no address and details printed on the inside flap ('Totally interior'), and looks 01–03 sharing the giant black tulle wide-brim hat, waist ribbons and lace-up boots, black/white striped-panel tunic, open black coat over patterned leggings on a black runway with audience on both sides. SS14 (shown Sept 2013) was indeed Ann's last collection before her Nov 2013 departure. Original Vogue Runway show page; not excluded; static only. name: 「The Concepts and Work of Issey Miyake」—— 三宅设计事务所官方作品页（A Piece of Cloth / Pleats / A-POC）
creator: Issey Miyake / Miyake Design Studio（MDS）
observation: 页头左上是双语锁定「Issey Miyake | 三宅一生」，右上 MDS 标志，再一行字距拉开的大写导航「WORK / BIOGRAPHY / AWARDS / PRESS / THE MIYAKE ISSEY FOUNDATION / 21_21 DESIGN SIGHT」。正文是一列约 680px 宽、约 19px 衬线、行高约 2.0 的时间线叙述（1960 世界设计会议→1970 事务所成立、「一块布」概念→1970s 新面料与传统工艺→1980s Body Series→1988 褶皱：把超大裁片夹在两层纸之间送入热压机收缩定型→1993 PLEATS PLEASE→1998 与藤原大开始 A-POC：一根线进入电脑编程的针织机，织出含有“铸造”式衣形的整幅布）。右侧是一条约 140px 宽的窄图轨：每张缩略图右下角带一个「+」，图下是约 9px 的衬线图注（作品名斜体、年份、摄影者）——「Cocoon Coat, 1976」「Plastic Body, 1980」「PLEATS PLEASE ISSEY MIYAKE, 1993」「Just Before [black], A-POC King & Queen [red]」（MAKING THINGS 展，2000，红色筒状针织悬挂）、《National Geographic》2003 的 A-POC Quatro Cotton 跨页、1998-12-27《纽约时报》版面。正文中间嵌着一个白底带阴影的「Voice Player / Narrator: Peter Barakan」音频条，和正文同宽。窄轨图像与左栏文字按年代对齐，文字段落之间留出整段空白以等待右侧图注。
translation: 历史区的归档构图：左列按时间叙述（我参加过的局的时间线），右侧窄轨放每局的小缩略图 + 日期 + 发起人的 9px 图注，图轨与文字按时间对齐、允许文字留白等图；票根打印：借 A-POC“一根线织出整卷、按需裁下一件”的逻辑——票根从一条连续的票带上按虚线裁出（打印动效：票带连续送出→裁切），而不是凭空出现一张卡；票面材质用“纸夹热压”的细褶纹理表达“已定型/已确认”；管理面板里的语音/说明条（如局前提醒）做成与正文同宽的内嵌条，而非浮层。

name: Maison Margiela「About / Our Maison · Since 1988」品牌自述页（含 1989 首秀档案照）
creator: Maison Margiela（Martin Margiela 1988 创立）
period: 叙述 1988 至今（官方页 2026-10 访问）
observation: 整页使用同一款打字机等宽字体（Courier 类，约 13px），包括左上的路径式面包屑「/INSIDE MAISON MARGIELA/ABOUT」和右下角的 cookie 面板（「▸ACCEPT」「▸DECLINE」带细框）。内容分节：「OUR MAISON」「SINCE 1988」「DESIGN PHILOSOPHY」「ARTISANAL」——节标题全大写顶左，正文向右缩进约 30px、每行约 50 个字符，链接一律用一个实心小三角「▸」前缀（「▸VIEW MORE」），没有下划线或按钮。版式是左窄右宽两栏：左栏约 380px 文字，右栏约 600px 宽的单张大图逐节对应；首图是整幅通栏的 Artisanal 系列合影（金色皱褶长裙居中），「SINCE 1988」对应一张黑白档案照：模特穿合身短西装、头部被面罩罩住、走在铺在地面的白布跑道上，观众直接坐在地板上，白布上留着走过的痕迹；「DESIGN PHILOSOPHY」对应一张过曝的工作室照（白大褂的工作人员在为花饰长裙试身）；「ARTISANAL」对应缀满珠宝的兜帽背影。文字块短（4–8 行），其余全是留白。
translation: 管理面板/发起人工具的字体分层：主理人视角（管理面板、改期弹层、取消确认）用等宽字体 + 全大写小节标 + 缩进正文 + 「▸」前缀动作，与成员视角的无衬线形成角色分层；局卡→详情的路径感：详情页顶部用「/我的局/已参加/火锅局」这样的路径式面包屑；历史区的归档构图：已结束的局像白布跑道上的脚印——时间线上只留轻的痕迹标记，不留完整卡片；留白比例：每节文字 4–8 行、其余留白，详情页信息块也按节分、不连排。
auditNote: seg0/seg1 show maisonmargiela.com's own About page in a single Courier-style monospace: '/INSIDE MAISON MARGIELA/ABOUT' path breadcrumb, cookie card with ▸ACCEPT/▸DECLINE (a corner panel, not a wall; content remains readable), uppercase section heads OUR MAISON / SINCE 1988 / DESIGN PHILOSOPHY / ARTISANAL with indented 4–8 line bodies and a ▸VIEW MORE link, left-narrow/right-wide two columns, the Artisanal group photo, the black-and-white 1989 archive photo (masked model in fitted jacket on a white cloth laid on the floor, audience seated on the floor, footprints on the cloth), the overexposed fitting photo and the jeweled hood. WebFetch independently confirmed the headings and the 'founded in Paris in 1988 by … Martin Margiela' text. Brand's own site is an original source; not excluded. Kept as designer rather than editorial: the monospace/typewriter system is a Margiela house code and the page is anchored on the SS1989 first show, not a shop grid. Translation names 管理面板/发起人工具 type layering, 详情页 path breadcrumb, 历史区 footprint markers, 详情页 section whitespace.

name: Alexander McQueen「Plato's Atlantis」SS2010 秀（Vogue Runway 秀页 + SHOWstudio 直播项目页）
creator: Lee Alexander McQueen；直播与影片 Nick Knight / SHOWstudio
period: 2009-10-06（秀）；Vogue Runway 归档页、SHOWstudio 项目页 2026-10 访问
observation: Vogue 秀页标题块三行居中：品牌「MCQUEEN」粗无衬线约 30px → 「SPRING 2010 READY-TO-WEAR」细字约 20px → 斜体衬线「By Lee McQueen」约 16px；二级导航是 COVERAGE / COLLECTION / DETAILS / BACKSTAGE / FRONT ROW 五个分段。Look 网格 3 列、每格约 244×365（2:3）、列距 8px，每张图左下角白色字距拉开的编号「01」「02」「03」（约 11px），右下角书签图标；画面是蓝光水面质感的亮白 T 台、模特穿爬行动物数码印花短裙和「犰狳鞋」。COLLECTION 幻灯页改为黑底：左栏「McQueen / SPRING 2010 READY-TO-WEAR / ← Look 1 / 46 →」三行计数器（品牌约 36px、季名 12px、计数 16px），中央单张竖图宽约 360px，底部一条可折叠缩略图带（HIDE COLLECTION，16 张约 68px 宽小图）。SHOWstudio 项目页：顶部「LAUNCHED ON 06 OCTOBER 2009」小字 + 导语，右栏「MAIN CONTRIBUTORS」四个带下划线的人名；项目索引为 01–06 六个编号条目（ESSAY / VIDEO RUNWAY SHOW / FASHION FILM / GALLERY / INTERVIEW / VIDEO），子页顶部一行「PART OF: PLATO'S ATLANTIS」+ 左侧小标签「ITEM 2 OF 6」；秀片海报帧里两台机械臂摄像机在 T 台两侧轨道上对称立起、模特缩成尽头一个小点，荧光黄六边形播放键压在海报左边缘（约一半在图外）。
translation: 局卡→详情的展开：详情标题块照搬「局名大 → 时间/地点细字 → 『由 xx 发起』斜体」三行比例（约 30:20:16）；名单的翻页：成员大图模式用「← 第 1 / 46 人 →」左栏计数器 + 底部可收起的头像带；系列局（同一局主的连办）用「PART OF: xx」面包屑 + 「ITEM 2 OF 6」角标表示当前是第几场；票根/详情的主操作按钮可像六边形播放键一样压在图片左边缘而不是放在图内。
auditNote: All six images support the observation: Vogue page with MCQUEEN / SPRING 2010 READY-TO-WEAR / By Lee McQueen three-line title, COVERAGE/COLLECTION/DETAILS/BACKSTAGE/FRONT ROW nav, 3-column look grid with '01/02/03' bottom-left and bookmark icons, blue-lit white runway with reptile-print dresses and armadillo shoes; black COLLECTION slideshow with the left 'McQueen / SPRING 2010 READY-TO-WEAR / ← Look 1 / 46 →' counter (crop-counter.png) and a HIDE COLLECTION thumbnail strip; SHOWstudio project page with 'LAUNCHED ON 06 OCTOBER 2009', 'VIEW INDEX (1/6)' and four underlined MAIN CONTRIBUTORS; sub-page with 'PART OF: PLATO'S ATLANTIS' and 'ITEM 2 OF 6'; poster frame with twin robotic-arm cameras on side tracks, the model a tiny figure at the far end, and the fluorescent-yellow hexagon play button overlapping the left edge about halfway. Vogue Runway show page and SHOWstudio (the live-stream's own producer) are original sources; cookie banners are bottom bars, not walls; not excluded; static only. name: Raf Simons AW2001「Riot Riot Riot」秀（Vogue Runway 归档页）

observation: 标题块「RAF SIMONS / FALL 2001 MENSWEAR / By Raf Simons」，作者行「BY STEFF YOTKA / JULY 10, 2017」说明这是回溯上传的归档，没有 DETAILS/BACKSTAGE 分段。三张 look（01–03）的背景是蓝光打亮的舞台脚手架（金属管架从地面搭到画面顶部），地面是深灰水泥，观众席在右侧暗处；模特几乎都遮脸：01 戴黑色面巾 + 迷彩军装外套 + 黑色长衣，02 金发低头穿卡其长风衣，03 两人并排拉起帽兜。图下编号「01」「02」「03」白色小字位于左下、书签在右下。左栏正文首字下沉「F」约 5 行高，正文衬线约 17px。页脚「LATEST FROM RAF SIMONS」3 列 6 张（SPRING 2023 … SPRING 2021 MENSWEAR），再下「MORE FROM RAF SIMONS」6 列重复同一组图。
translation: 历史区的归档构图：已结束的局卡用深色「脚手架」背景（细线网格 + 低饱和蓝）和水泥灰底，与进行中的局的亮底区分；名单的角色分层：未公开身份/匿名报名的成员用「遮脸」头像（帽兜/面巾式的深色占位）而非默认灰头像；局卡上的编号用白色小字放左下角、操作图标放右下角，两者同一基线。
auditNote: vogue-top.png confirms title block 'RAF SIMONS / FALL 2001 MENSWEAR / By Raf Simons', byline 'BY STEFF YOTKA / JULY 10, 2017', nav with only COVERAGE / COLLECTION (no DETAILS/BACKSTAGE), drop-cap 'F' ~4–5 lines, and three looks on a blue-lit scaffolding stage with dark concrete floor; crop-looks.png confirms 01 black face covering + camo jacket + long black coat, 02 blonde head-down in khaki trench, 03 two hooded models side by side, white '01/02/03' bottom-left and bookmark bottom-right. vogue-latest.png confirms 'LATEST FROM RAF SIMONS' 3×6 (SPRING 2023 … SPRING 2021 MENSWEAR), outlined VIEW ALL, and 'MORE FROM RAF SIMONS' 6-col row repeating the same six images. Vogue Runway show page = allowed source; not excluded; specific show so 'designer' fits; translation names 历史区, 名单 anonymity avatars, 局卡 corner placement.

name: Dries Van Noten SS2015 苔藓地毯秀（Vogue Runway 秀页）
creator: Dries Van Noten；地毯 Alexandra Kehayoglou
observation: 二级导航有六段：COVERAGE / COLLECTION / DETAILS / BACKSTAGE / FRONT ROW / ATMOSPHERE。三张 look 图里整条 T 台铺着一块手工簇绒的「苔藓」地毯（蓝绿、黄绿、灰绿色块起伏），金色逆光从远端打来，每张图里远处都能看见后续模特排成一列；衣服是金色绣花外套、条纹丝绸、印花吊带裙，颜色与地毯的黄绿相呼应。正文之后被付费墙截断，但 DETAILS 区仍显示 6 张细节裁切（01 金色外套 + 手袋、02/03 白色厚底凉鞋踩在地毯上、04 条纹披肩、05 项链、06 手拿包），3 列、每张约 268×365；BACKSTAGE 区 6 张化妆特写同样 3 列编号 01–06，每区下面一个描边按钮「SUBSCRIBE TO VIEW ALL」。
translation: 我参加的局列表：同一天/同一场地的多张局卡共用一条连续的「底材」（如统一的纹理底或同一色带贯穿多卡），表示它们在同一现场；局详情的分段参考 COLLECTION / DETAILS / BACKSTAGE / FRONT ROW：成员 / 细节（地点、费用、装备的裁切小图）/ 幕后（仅局主可见的管理面板）/ 到场（签到名单）；细节区用 3 列裁切图 + 左下编号，而不是文字列表。
auditNote: vogue-top.png shows the six-segment nav COVERAGE / COLLECTION / DETAILS / BACKSTAGE / FRONT ROW / ATMOSPHERE, three looks on the tufted moss carpet with golden backlight and queued models in the distance (gold embroidered coat, striped silk, printed slip dress), and the start of DETAILS; vogue-details-backstage.png shows DETAILS 01–06 in 3 cols (gold coat + bag, white platform sandals on carpet ×2, striped shawl, necklace, clutch) and BACKSTAGE 01–06 makeup close-ups, each followed by an outlined 'SUBSCRIBE TO VIEW ALL'. Image sizes (~268×365) are consistent with the screenshot. Vogue Runway show page = allowed source; not excluded; a specific show so 'designer' fits; translation names 我参加的局列表 shared ground, 局详情 section taxonomy, 细节区 3-col crops.

name: Dries Van Noten「Women Spring Summer 2027」秀页（品牌官网，含秀场片）
creator: Dries Van Noten（创意总监 Julian Klausner）；网站 driesvannoten.com
observation: 页面顶部是一整屏自动播放的秀场片（首屏高约 900px），下面居中标题「WOMEN SPRING SUMMER / 2027」字距拉开的小号大写（约 18px，两行），再下是 Julian Klausner 的三段斜体衬线引言（约 22px、居中、栏宽约 980px），落款「– Julian Klausner」正体。Look 网格 4 列、每列约 290px、列距 40px、图 290×516（约 9:16），每张图左下角内缩约 20px 处有一个直径约 18px 的黑色圆点、内含白色数字 1、2、3…；首屏只放 8 张，下面是描边按钮「+ SHOW ALL」，再下「DETAILS」4 列细节裁切，最后是「ENJOY COMPLIMENTARY GIFT WRAPPING…」促销与三栏页脚。秀场片（从页面 video 源下载，5 秒）：f01 四位模特在白色地面上向左走、背后是水泥板墙和沿墙坐成一排的观众；f02–f05 不同模特依次经过（红白条纹针织裙、淡黄风衣、裸粉半裙），画面始终平视、相机不动，人物在画面里横向穿过。
translation: 局卡→详情的展开：详情顶部用一段静音自动循环的现场短片，标题「局名 / 日期」用小号字距拉开的两行放在视频之下而不是压在视频上；局主的一句话用斜体居中放在名单之前；名单的角色分层：每个头像左下角一个 18px 黑圆点白数字表示报名顺序，超过 8 人折叠成「+ 查看全部」描边按钮。
auditNote: Static claims are supported: lazy-0.png shows the ~900px hero region, letterspaced two-line 'WOMEN SPRING SUMMER / 2027', three italic centered quote paragraphs signed '– Julian Klausner', and a 4-col look grid at 290px columns / 40px gaps / ~516px tall with a black circular numbered badge bottom-left (crop-badge-zoom.png confirms the white-on-black '1'); lazy-1.png shows only 8 looks then an outlined '+ SHOW ALL', followed by DETAILS in 4 cols; ss27-women-lazy.png shows the gift-wrapping promo and 3-col footer. Film frames (f01/f03/f05, sheet.png) match: static level camera, models crossing a white floor in front of concrete panel walls with seated audience, striped knit / pale yellow trench / pink skirt. Official brand site = original source; not excluded; a specific show page so 'designer' fits; translation names 局卡→详情 hero film, 局主一句话, 名单 numbered badges and 8-person fold. Status downgraded: the only motion evidence is frames extracted from the page's video source file, and the page screenshots show the hero area blank, so no page-level recording shows the interface itself changing. 'Still acceptable' as static.

name: Thom Browne「Mens Spring 2027 Runway」秀页（品牌官网，含秀场片）
creator: Thom Browne；网站 thombrowne.com
period: 2026 年 6 月（米兰秀）；官网秀页 2026-10 访问
observation: 页头：左上小号大写「MENS SPRING 2027 RUNWAY」（约 10px），右上一对描边按钮「MENS ARCHIVE」「WOMENS ARCHIVE」（约 140×28px）；其下是一条灰色播放器栏（播放键、00:00 / 00:00、细进度线、静音与全屏图标）。Look 网格 4 列、每格约 280×420（2:3）、列距 30px，图片右下角用约 8px 的灰黑小字写「MENS SPRING 2027 RUNWAY - LOOK 1」压在碎石地面上，44 个 look 全部如此编号。录屏帧：f01 页面空白 → f02 网格以约 35% 不透明度淡入 → f03 完全显示，说明网格是整体渐显而不是逐张出现。秀场片（从页面 video 源取前 28 秒）：f00–f01 全景——米兰宫殿庭院、黑伞下的观众坐在两侧、碎石 T 台两边摆满小白盆的金属花；f02–f04 三位模特穿灰白西装+百褶裙、头罩养蜂人面纱、共撑一把白伞并排走来；f07 低机位掠过一排盆花；f12–f13 换成蓝伞 + 深灰套装、庭院出现长阴影。
translation: 票根：票面上的局名+序号像「RUNWAY - LOOK 1」一样用 8px 小字印在图片内右下角，而不是作为独立文字行；改期弹层旧→新对照：用「MENS ARCHIVE / WOMENS ARCHIVE」这种等宽成对描边按钮承载「旧时间 / 新时间」两列；局卡→详情的展开：详情页的名单网格整体从 35% 淡到 100%，而非逐格弹入；历史区的归档：已结束的局在详情顶部放一条 00:00 进度条式的回顾视频栏。
auditNote: crop-top.png confirms small-caps 'MENS SPRING 2027 RUNWAY' top-left, paired outlined 'MENS ARCHIVE' / 'WOMENS ARCHIVE' buttons (~140×28), the grey player bar (play, 00:00 / 00:00, thin progress line, mute, fullscreen), and a 4-col grid of ~280×420 images with ~30px gaps; crop-caption-zoom.png confirms the tiny grey 'MENS SPRING 2027 RUNWAY - LOOK 1' caption printed inside the image bottom-right over gravel, and lazy-1/lazy-2 show every look captioned the same way. vid/sheet.png genuinely shows the interface changing: frame 1 header with empty body, frame 2 the whole grid at reduced opacity, frame 3 fully rendered, so the whole-grid fade-in is verified and 已看动效 stands. Film frames (film/sheet, f01, f03, f08, f13) match: Milan palazzo courtyard, audience under black umbrellas, potted metal flowers lining a gravel runway, three beekeeper-veiled models in grey-white suits/pleated skirts under a shared white umbrella, a low pass over the pots, later a blue umbrella + dark suit with long shadows. Official brand site = original source; not excluded; a specific show page so 'designer' fits; translation names 票根, 改期弹层 paired buttons, 局卡→详情 grid fade, 历史区 review bar. One factual nit to fix in the observation: the grid holds more than 44 looks (lazy-2 shows a further full row after LOOK 44 and the full-page shot ends with a single extra image), so '44 个 look' should be corrected, but the design claim (every look captioned inline) holds.

name: UNDERCOVER 2027 Spring-Summer「Poisonous plants」系列页（品牌官网）
creator: Jun Takahashi / UNDERCOVER；网站 undercoverism.com
period: 2026 年（系列发布）；官网系列页 2026-10 访问
observation: 标题两行居中：「2027 SPRING - SUMMER」粗体约 22px，副题「Poisonous plants」常规约 14px，两行间距约 10px。Look 网格通栏 4 列、无外边距、格间只有 1px 白线，每格 320×480（2:3）；编号「01」…「40」用约 11px 白色小字放在图片右下角内缩约 20px 处，没有任何标题或图注。全部 40 张都是夜间海滩闪光灯直打：人物亮、碎石滩和海浪在后面压成深蓝黑，少数几张（18、23、37–40）露出粉紫色晚霞；衣服上印着古典肖像与花瓶的画片。第 40 张之后接两张半宽的白天合影（一组深色西装 6 人坐在消波块上、一组彩色雨衣 5 人站在礁石上），作为系列收尾。左侧站点菜单（NEW ARRIVALS / COMING SOON / NEWS …）以文字列表叠在网格左缘上。
translation: 名单的角色分层：成员头像用通栏 4 列、1px 细缝、角上白色小序号的构图，不加边框和名字行，名字在点开时才出现；历史区的归档构图：已结束的局用「夜间闪光灯」式处理（人物保留亮度、背景压暗成深蓝黑），进行中的局保持日光底；局结束后的合影作为名单最后一行的半宽格出现，和单人头像区分开；中文局名与时间的比例：局名粗体 22px 与副题（主题句）常规 14px 两行居中。
auditNote: Evidence (full page, header crop, number crop, two grid segments) shows undercoverism.com 2027SS page exactly as described: two-line centered heading, 4-col edge-to-edge grid with 1px gutters, white corner indices 01–40, night-flash beach shots with pink dusk on 18/38–40, two half-width daytime group shots after look 40, left text menu overlapping the grid. Brand's own site, not excluded, static only, designer collection (lookbook not shop grid), translation names concrete 我的局 areas. Caveat: tiles 31–34 and 36 are lazy-load placeholders, so 'all 40' is verified for 35 of 40.

name: Craig Green SS26 秀图页（品牌官网「SS26 IMAGE」）
creator: Craig Green；网站 craig-green.com
observation: 页头只有「Store / Collections / Project Archive」三个文字链接和一个居中的黑色圆环 logo（约 56px）。正文是通栏 5 列、无缝的 look 网格，每格约 256×384（2:3），共 44 张：8 整行 + 最后一行 4 张、右下角留一个空白格。所有图同一机位：灰绿色墙面做背景，画面下三分之一是一条刷上去的亮黄色颜料 T 台（边缘有笔刷的毛边），模特戴透明护目镜式的无框镜片；第一行从黑色风衣 → 白色格纹 → 卡其风衣 → 淡紫衬衫 → 粉色花卉拼布，色相逐格变化。没有编号、图注或 look 计数，页脚只有 About / Contact / Stockists 和一个邮件订阅框。
translation: 我参加的局列表：同一局的成员头像用 5 列无缝网格、不加名字，只靠「同一底色带」（黄色颜料带→对应局的主题色带）表明属于同一局；名单末尾留一个空白格作为「+ 邀请」入口，而不是在列表外另放按钮；局卡→详情的展开：详情顶部用极简页头（三个文字链接 + 圆环 logo）让整屏留给网格。
auditNote: Screenshots of craig-green.com/collections/ss26-image show the three-link header with ring logo, 5-col seamless 2:3 grid (8 full rows + 4 = 44 with an empty bottom-right cell), brushed yellow runway, clear goggles, the described first-row colour sequence, no captions/numbers, and the About/Contact/Stockists + email footer. Cookie banner is a corner overlay, not a wall. Brand's own site, not excluded, static, specific designer collection, translation names concrete places (成员网格、+邀请空白格、详情页头).

name: Walter Van Beirendonck AW2026-27「SCARE the CROW / SCARECROW」请柬与秀前言（设计师官网系列索引）
creator: Walter Van Beirendonck；网站 waltervanbeirendonck.com（Asprinox 制作）

translation: 我参加的局 / 我发起的局 列表：可用「# / 局名 / 人数 / 日期」的表格行（行高 43px、人数带下划线可点、表尾一行总计），而不是卡片流；票根：票面层级照搬请柬——局名手绘粗体占三分之一、「星期三 1 月 21 日 – 4:30 PM」是第二大的行、地址三行缩一级、底部联系人小字；票根的背面（灯箱第 2 页）放局主前言：居中短行、分段、落款「XXX 局主名」。
auditNote: waltervanbeirendonck.com collections index matches: red condensed two-line title, 'ALL COLLECTIONS / 1986 — PRESENT', star-separated marquee, four filter chips, black-header table (# / COLLECTION TITLE / LOOKS / SEASON / YEAR) with underlined titles and look counts, 'TOTAL: 83 COLLECTIONS SHOWN'. Lightbox 1/2 is the invitation with the exact date/venue hierarchy, 2/2 the show notes with 'XXX WALTER' and tracked URL. Designer's own site, not excluded, static, specific show. Minor inaccuracy: notes have ~11 paragraphs rather than 9.

name: Iris van Herpen「Sensory Seas」SS2020 高定秀（Vogue Runway 秀页）
creator: Iris van Herpen
observation: 标题块「IRIS VAN HERPEN / SPRING 2020 COUTURE / By Iris van Herpen」，作者「BY AMY VERNER / JANUARY 20, 2020」带圆形头像。三张 look 图背景全黑、地面是哑光的赭棕色，背景里悬着几条蓝白渐变的发光丝带（像在黑暗里缓慢摆动的触手）。01 黑色细褶长裙 + 从肩到腰的流苏绳结背带；02 米灰色激光切割裙，表面是放射状重复的小鳞片单元，从胸口向下摆扩散成半透明层；03 黑白相间的扇形褶裥从左肩斜向右腰、层层叠成阶梯。图片编号与书签位置同 Vogue 模板（左下 01，右下书签）。正文首字「B」下沉 4 行，栏宽约 370px。页脚「LATEST FROM IRIS VAN HERPEN」3 列。
translation: 票根撕票：撕口边缘不用直线锯齿，而用像 look 02 那样放射状重复的小鳞片/孔洞单元，撕开后两侧边缘各保留半个单元；局卡→详情的展开：详情背景用深色 + 一两条低亮度的渐变光带作为「正在进行」的动势暗示，光带放在卡片之后、文字之前；中文局名与时间的比例：标题三行保持 30:20:16。
auditNote: Vogue Runway show page (an allowed original source) shows the IRIS VAN HERPEN / SPRING 2020 COUTURE title block, Amy Verner Jan 20 2020 byline with round avatar, three looks on black with ochre floor and blue-white light ribbons, 01/02/03 bottom-left with bookmark bottom-right, 4-line drop cap, 3-col 'Latest from' footer, all matching the observation. Subscriber banner truncates the gallery after look 03 but the described content is fully visible; not a blank/cookie wall. Not excluded, static, translation concrete.

name: COMME des GARÇONS 官网首页：《Six》Number 5 / 1990 对页
creator: COMME des GARÇONS（川久保玲）；《Six》杂志 1988–1991
period: 1990（杂志期号）；官网首页 2026-10 访问
observation: 官网首页是一张满屏的杂志对页，没有导航文字：左页是放大到溢出页面的黄色向日葵（印刷网点清晰可见、蓝灰天空只剩角落），「Six」用斜体衬线放在右下角、字高约为页面高度的 8%，其下一行字距拉开的「Number 5/1990」约 11px；右页是 Enzo Cucchi 的黑白肖像，脸的上半部被水滴网点吃掉，「Enzo Cucchi / Six」靠右放在肖像中部，图注「Untitled, 1987 Enzo Cucchi. Portrait by Timothy Greenfield-Sanders ©1989」压在右下。整站唯一的 chrome 是左上角纵向排列的数字「1 2 3 4 5 6 7」（约 22px 粗体），分别链接到 index / cdg / junyawatanabe / noir / stores / subscribe / recruitment；第 2 页（cdg.html）是灰色网点大圆的满版图案，左侧只写「2027SS COLLECTION / COMME des GARÇONS」两行黑字。连续 6 帧（9 秒）截图画面完全不变，是静态页。

name: Thomas Gertenbach 作品集「石膏桌上的拍立得」（FWA of the Day · 2026-10-10）
creator: Thomas Gertenbach（Creative Developer）
period: FWA of the Day 2026-10-10（82 分 / 6 天）；站点 2026
observation: FWA 首页与案例页都标「10 OCTOBER · FWA OF THE DAY · Thomas Gertenbach portfolio」，作者自述「My portfolio is one sunlit plaster table, seen from above. Projects are polaroids you can pick up, toss and blow around」。实际打开站点（软件 WebGL，加载慢）：加载态是一块暖灰底（约 #a8a394）上的取景框——四角「⌜ ⌝ ⌞ ⌟」+ 中央一条黑色横线，左下角「ISO 100 · F/8 · 1/125」相机参数，右下角百分比；百分比从 0% → 33% → 53% → 78% → 94% 逐帧递增时，四角取景框同步向中心收拢、横线变长（vid1/sheet f03→f13、drag/f00→f04）。加载完成后（drag/f05）切成俯视的混凝土质感石膏桌面：五六张白边拍立得散落、各自随机旋转 5–20°，每张下方手写体标题（Spyker / Cinnamon / Momiji / Meuble / Gielissen），桌面上投着树叶的软阴影，中央仍留着那条黑横线；滚轮之后（drag/f06）镜头拉远，露出整张带圆角凹槽的桌面，拍立得聚到左上区域、尺寸缩至约一半，右下角出现一块方形浅凹槽，左下角出现一块菱形投影（被拎起的卡片的影子）。第二次录制（drag2/sheet：f00–f03 停在 94%，f04 桌面近景、f05 滚轮后拉远）复现了完全相同的三段序列；两次都是在鼠标按下/松开后才从取景框切到桌面。
translation: 局卡→详情的展开可以借「取景框四角收拢 + 一条横线」做加载/过渡骨架，而不是转圈；历史区的归档构图：参加过的局做成带白边、随机轻旋转的「拍立得」散落在一张有光影的桌面上，卡片下方手写局名，拉远即成网格式归档；票根撕票后的卡片可留下一块「投影」表示被拿走。
auditNote: FWA home/case screenshots show '10 OCTOBER FWA OF THE DAY – Thomas Gertenbach portfolio', 82 points / 6 days, and the quoted plaster-table blurb. vid1, drag and drag2 contact sheets genuinely show the interface changing: percentage counter climbing (00→33→53→64→78→80→87→94%), the four viewfinder corners converging and the center line lengthening, then the cut to the concrete table with hand-captioned polaroids (Spyker/Muuble/Cinnamon/Momiji/Gielissen/Auremin), then the pull-back revealing the rounded tray, square recess and rhombus shadow (f05/f06). Motion verified. URL is the creator's own portfolio (original source). Not on the excluded list. Translation names concrete 我的局 surfaces (局卡→详情 loader, 历史区归档, 票根). Minor nit: card reads 'Muuble', observation writes 'Meuble'.

name: Reposaku（レポサク）智慧农业平台 — Good Design Gold Award 2025（Web-based service）
creator: Ezowin Inc.（北海道）· 设计 Ayana Yamazaki
period: 2025 Good Design Gold Award（Award No. 25G181414）；服务 2020/04 上线
observation: G-Mark 2025 结果页 Gold Award 19 项中唯一的数字服务（「Web-based service / Ezowin Inc.」）。奖项 Gallery 页主图三台手机：左一是航拍底图上按地块着色（绿 / 蓝 / 橙）的多边形，每块压一枚带编号的圆形图钉（「2」「7」）；中间手机的一块田里铺满平行彩色细线（作业轨迹），线上一枚带拖拉机插画的圆形头像标当前位置，屏幕外散落黄色铲车、蓝色卡车等小车辆插画，用虚线连向屏幕；右侧手机 UI 为日文：左上「←トップ」返回胶囊、顶部日期区间胶囊「今日 06/01(月)〜06/05(月)」、右侧竖排一列圆形图标按钮「掲示板 / 道具箱 / 一括選択」，底图仍是地块地图。页面下方表格：分类 System & Service、Companies Ezowin Inc.、Award No. 25G181414；Outline 写「Visualizes the real-time movements of dozens of vehicles with 12cm accuracy… Designed for intuitive use, enabling participation by all, including older adults」；Points of design 第 3 条「“使ってみたい”が芽生える操作体験で、「ITわからん」が口癖の人や高齢者含め関係者全員の参加を実現」；评审语强调 thoroughly user-friendly service design、「operations… can be intuitively handled by elderly or inexperienced users」。
translation: 局详情的「到场 / 位置」层：地图上每位成员一枚带头像的圆形图钉，主办者的移动画成彩色细线；我的局顶部日期条照抄「今日 06/01(月)〜06/05(月)」的区间胶囊写法（中文可写「本周 10/13(一)〜10/19(日)」）；主办管理面板用右侧竖排的圆形图标按钮（公告板 / 工具箱 / 批量选择）对应「公告 / 物料 / 批量通知」。
auditNote: g-mark.org gallery winners page is the award body (original). hero.png shows the three-phone key visual exactly as described: colored field polygons with numbered circular pins, parallel colored track lines with a tractor avatar and pin '2', yellow digger/blue truck illustrations outside the screen, and the Japanese UI with 「←トップ」, date-range chip 「今日 06/01(月)〜06/05(月)」 and vertical icon rail 掲示板/道具箱/一括選択. outline.png confirms System & Service, Ezowin Inc., Award No. 25G181414, designer Ayana Yamazaki, the Outline text and the three Points of design verbatim; page.png shows the jury evaluation. Cookie banner partially overlaps but does not block content. Not excluded. Static status is correct. Translation names concrete places (局详情到场层, 我的局顶部日期条, 主办管理面板). The '19 Gold Awards, only digital service' claim is not shown in these images but is peripheral.

name: My Japan Railway / TRAIN TRIP 数字站章 — D&AD Black Pencil 2024（Art Direction）
creator: Dentsu Inc. Tokyo（ECD 八木義博、AD 加藤寛之）for JR Group
period: 活动 2022（铁道 150 周年）起持续；D&AD 2024 Black Pencil + Yellow + 2 Graphite + 2 Wood；Cannes Lions 2023 Industry Craft Grand Prix
observation: D&AD 条目页：标题「My Japan Railway」，Awards 行依次 1 枚黑铅笔 + 1 黄 + 2 灰 + 2 木 + 3 个空六边形（shortlist）；Categories 标签 Art Direction / Illustration / Branding / Graphic Design / Digital Experience Design / Typography / Digital Marketing，Countries Japan，Year 2024；Credits Entrant/Advertising/Design Agency 均为 Dentsu Inc. Tokyo，Client JR Group。Hero 图是手机打开 railway150.jp：浅灰地图上站点为灰色小圆点、最近站为红色定位针，旁白「Touch to collect stamp of nearest station」。JR 官站 railway150.jp（标题「TRAIN TRIP｜JRグループ」，「DL不要のWEBアプリ」）手机界面自上而下：顶栏「TRAIN TRIP」+ 汉堡；左上计数「003 / 693」（已集 / 总数）+ 小字；居中大字「GET!」+ 一句小字；一枚八角形橙色站章（墨色不均、边缘粗糙，内有站名汉字「東比春駅」式黑体、建筑/人物插画与「MY JAPAN RAILWAY 150th」环文）；章下站名（黑体）+ 盖章日期时间 + 序号两行小字；底部通栏「他のスタンプを探す」胶囊与一枚圆形返回钮。电通报（电通自家媒体）文章图：900+ 枚站章排成密网格，每枚单色或双色（绿 / 橙 / 蓝 / 红）的木版画风，站名用日文汉字 + 英文「Sta.」；放大图说明「The intensity of the stamp changes the degree of blurring, and the date/time stamped and the order in which it was stamped are also recorded」。
translation: 历史区的归档构图：每个参加过的局生成一枚单色「局章」（八角 / 圆形、粗糙边缘、局名汉字 + 日期），按时间排成密网格；「签到成功」瞬间用「计数 003/693 → 大字 GET! → 章 → 局名 → 时间戳 + 序号」五段竖排；签到入口照抄「地图最近站点 + 红色定位针 + 一句提示」；章的墨色深浅随准时/迟到变化，作为票根撕票之外的另一种「到场凭证」。
